title: Exploring the Competitive Dimension of Omnichannel Retailing
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The treatment is a competitor's one-time BOPS launch: after = 1*(month.in > 8), identical for every unit, interacted with a time-invariant treatment-group indicator (treat = DMA median customer distance to the competitor's nearest store < 50 miles for the online channel; store within 5 miles / co-located for the brick-and-mortar channel). All regressions are plm within / xtreg fe of log purchases on treat:after with month FE and time-varying DMA/store controls (CONTROLS placeholder; unemployment, households etc.), SEs clustered by DMA/store. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-cohorts rule and also carries time-varying controls in every column.
design_notes: DMA-month (online channel) and store-month (B&M channel) panels built from proprietary transaction data of a national department store chain (transaction.txt, customer.txt, department.txt; not shipped). month.in = month + 12*(year-2014), 24 months in 2014-2015. Code.R line 91: aggr$treat = ifelse(distance_median < 50, 1, 0); aggr$after = ifelse(month.in > 8, 1, 0). Models fixed1a..fixed1x, fixed2a..fixed2e: plm(lnpurchase ~ treat:after + factor(month.in) + CONTROLS, index = c('dma','month.in'), model = 'within'), with vcovHC cluster = 'group'; intensity variant intens:after; returns models add lnpurchase as a control. Stata mirror: xtreg lnpurchase Treat_After i.monthin CONTROLS, fe robust. Replication Appendix describes placebo dates, PSM and IPW robustness.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One competitor launch date (month.in = 9, i.e., September 2014) applied to all treated DMAs/stores.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (after = month.in > 8 for all units); time-varying controls
specs.treatment_definition: treat = DMA with population-weighted median customer distance to nearest competitor store < 50 miles; after = month.in > 8
specs.controls: CONTROLS (DMA-level time-varying economic controls, e.g., unemployment, households)
specs.reported_location: Table 2, Model 1 (subsequent models vary thresholds/samples; B&M models use STORE as unit)

data_files_note: No data shipped; package holds R and Stata code, logs, a data dictionary and a replication appendix. Transaction-level data belong to the focal retailer.
software_note: R (plm, sandwich, lmtest) with a Stata mirror (xtreg fe robust)
screener_notes: Classic two-group, single-event DiD; 'staggered' in the full-text hit list refers to robustness checks, not to adoption timing. Not eligible.
